title: nassella dasycarpa
intro: Nassella dasycarpa, commonly known as Junegrass or Bluebunch Wheatgrass, is a perennial grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Nassella dasycarpa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
